_doc: Dishes with NO fair picture yet (dish_art.py: a picture of its own form, or one that reads the same, showing no food it does not contain). Each shows the least wrong picture drawn (given) until art is made for it (wants). Written by `py tools/content/kitchen/dish_art.py --write`; tests/test_dish_art.py checks the list is exactly the dishes the rule cannot place, and that it only shrinks. `wanted` counts, for the art to come, the dishes per form, tier and benefit that show another form, tier or benefit today.
